recording_selection.note: The same selected recording is reused across all four conditions for each subject.

conditions.purpose: DEAP-like passband at original sampling rate

valid_pairwise_interpretations.B_vs_D: sampling-rate change with a shared 4-45 Hz passband
valid_pairwise_interpretations.A_vs_C: descriptive only; sampling rate and feasible upper bandwidth differ

limitations: ICLabel outputs are model predictions, not component ground truth.
ICA is refit per condition, so component indices are not paired across conditions.
The source BCI recordings were acquired with their original hardware filters and notch filtering.
This comparison cannot by itself establish a universal causal sampling-rate requirement for ICLabel.
